jobs_results.title: Senior Java Developer | AWS | 100% Remote
jobs_results.description:
🚀We are looking for the very Top Talent…and we would be delighted if you were to join our team!

More in details, UST is a multinational company based in North America, certified as a Top Employer company with over 35.000 employees all over the world and presence in more than 30 countries. We are leaders on digital technology services, and we provide large-scale technologic solutions to big companies.

🔎 What are we looking for?

We are looking for a Senior Java Developer to be part of our team working with a highly digitalized top bank customer in US&UK Market. This role will be focused on making service improvements, small service evolutions...

This is a fully remote position for candidates based in Spain

📋 Requirements:
• +6 years of experience as Developer
• Production-grade experience of developing and managing API’s using Java & Springboot. Excellent understanding of SOLID principles, SOA, HTTP and REST.
• Development experience within AWS
• Good knowledge of Gradle.
•... Production experience running microservices on container orchestration architectures.
• Passionate about API testing utilising tools similar to Wiremock, Pact, Postman and Cucumber.
• Good understanding of API authentication and authorisation mechanisms like OAuth.
• Understand the concept of distributed tracing and have some experience working with logging tools
• Basic knowledge of infrastructure as code and CI/CD pipeline management via Jenkins.
• Strong experience in back-end architectural and design patterns.
• Good knowledge of distributed systems at backend with a proven track record in Performance, Scalability, and Resiliency.
• Advanced English level (B2-C1)

📋Desirable requirements:
• Experience with Agile methodologies
• NodeJS experience
• Good knowledge of Maven
• Knowledge using monitoring & logging tools like NewRelic or Logzio to troubleshoot problems in a distributed network of systems.
• Experience with monitoring, alerting and notifications (NewRelic, Grafana, AppDynamics, Logz.io, …) with demonstrable observability implementations.
• Experience with process automation
• Working knowledge with support platform tools (ServiceNow, PagerDuty…)

📋Main tasks and responsibilities:
• Work as part of a SRE cross-functional group of engineers in applying Site Reliability Engineering principles to in-house developed front-end applications.
• Have a clear oversight on how managed systems relate to each other, with autonomy to continuously iterate improvements to achieve highly available, fault tolerant applications.
• Identify, troubleshoot and pre-empt operational issues being able to understand and modify code.
• Preserve the platform health and implement tech compliance
• Drive engineering best practice (e.g, Operational Excellence, Security, Quality, Resilience etc.) and set standards across the team.
• Estimate, scope and plan your work within an agile environment.
• Willingness to be part of a 24/7 on-call rota (paid additionally)

What can we offer?

✈️ 23 days of Annual Leave plus the 24th and 31st of December as discretionary days!

❤️ Numerous benefits (Health Care Plan, teleworking compensation, Life and Accident Insurances).

🍴 `Retribución Flexible´ Program: (Meals, Kinder Garden, Transport, online English lessons, Health Care Plan…)

🎓 Free access to several training platforms

🚀 Professional stability and career plans

🚶 UST also, compensates referrals from which you could benefit when you refer professionals.

🔗 The option to pick between 12 or 14 payments along the year.

🏡 Real Work Life Balance measures (flexibility, WFH or remote work policy, compacted hours during summertime…)

🎁 UST Club Platform discounts and gym Access discounts

If you would like to know more, don’t hesitate to apply and we’ll get in touch to fill you in detail. We are waiting for you

jobs_results.title: Desarrollador/a Senior de Microservicios Java
jobs_results.description:
En Vermont Solutions estamos buscando para nuestro cliente del sector financiero un/a Desarrollador/a Senior con un mínimo de 4 años de experiencia en el desarrollo de Microservicios con JAVA 8/11/17 y SpringBoot. El candidato ideal deberá tener habilidades avanzadas en Spring Boot, Spring Cloud y Spring Data/JPA, así como experiencia en diseño de patrones, arquitectura hexagonal, pruebas automáticas y seguridad.

Modalidad de trabajo: 100% remoto

Requisitos Obligatorios:
• Experiencia comprobada en nuevo desarrollo con Microservicios utilizando JAVA 8/11/17 y SpringBoot.
• Amplia experiencia en Spring Boot y Spring Data/JPA.
• Experiencia en Spring Cloud y/o Spring Webflux
• Conocimiento y aplicación de diseño de patrones, arquitectura hexagonal, pruebas automáticas y seguridad.
• Capacidad analítica para abordar problemas complejos y encontrar soluciones efectivas.
• Experiencia en la documentación de APIs utilizando SWAGGER/OpenAPI3.
• Experiencia con bases de datos relacionales... como Postgre u Oracle.
• Experiencia en pruebas unitarias con cobertura utilizando Junit/Mockito.
• Experiencia en CI/CD utilizando herramientas como Git, Jenkins, Sonar, Fortify, u otras similares.

Requisitos Deseables:
• Conocimientos en Programación Reactiva: Spring WebFlux, R2DBC.
• Familiaridad con Clusters, utilizando tecnologías como Docker, Kubernetes, Openshift.
• Conocimientos en servicios de Cloud Azure, específicamente en Servicios BLOB, EventHub y Active Directory.

Nivel de inglés

Mínimo un B2 alto ya que se realizarán interlocuciones con diferentes equipos en inglés.

Ofrecemos:
• Plan de Formación y certificaciones técnicas.
• Desarrollo profesional y plan de carrera definido.
• Flexibilidad horaria
• Plan de retribución flexible acorde a tus necesidades (seguro médico privado, cheques formación para estudiar idiomas, cheques guardería, tarjeta transporte...).
• Integración en un equipo de profesionales motivados, en un ambiente de trabajo innovador y dinámico.
• Modelo de gestión sostenible y políticas de igualdad efectiva, ambientes de trabajo abiertos e inclusivos

jobs_results.title: Desarrollador/a Java (con certificado de discapacidad)
jobs_results.description:
Eurofirms Foundation busca para importante empresa de consultoría y servicios digitales, ubicada en Barcelona, un/a PROGRAMADOR/A JAVA, para realizar las siguientes funciones:

- Desarrollar componentes y nuevas funcionalidades de aplicaciones correspondientes a los casos de uso, alcanzando los parámetros de calidad establecidos durante el ciclo de vida del software.

- Realizar mantenimiento preventivo, correctivo y evolutivo de sus aplicaciones.

- Colaborar proactivamente con el resto de miembros del equipo técnico en la definición de la arquitectura.

- Participar activamente en la evolución tecnológica del equipo manteniéndose al día en la tecnología utilizada.

- Apoyar el diseño de las soluciones que den mejor respuesta a las necesidades de cada proyecto a partir de los recursos y capacidades disponibles.

- Desarrollar integraciones entre sistemas de información.

- Dar soporte técnico y funcional a los usuarios.

Requisitos:

- Imprescindible Formación en DESARROLLO DE... APLICACIONES WEB (DAW) o DESARROLLO DE APLICACIONES MULTIPLATAFORMA (DAM) O SIMILAR.

- Mínimo 2 años de experiencia en una posición similar

- Desarrollo en entornos JAVA.

- Lenguajes de programación Frontend como VueJS, Angular o React.

- Persona comprometida, responsable, con don de gentes.

- Residencia cercana al puesto de trabajo.

- Certificado de discapacidad, igual o superior al 33%.

Ofrecemos:

Estabilidad laboral e incorporación inmediata.

Flexibilidad horaria de entrada y salida.

Jornadas intensivas (verano, Semana Santa, Navidad y todos los viernes del año)

28 días hábiles de vacaciones al año.

Modelo híbrido de teletrabajo

• Un/a profesional con al menos 2 años de experiencia en desarrollo SW en Java.
• Residencia en MADRID o alrededores, con disponibilidad para CIERTA PRESENCIALIDAD en Torrejón de Ardoz o Aranjuez, por necesidades de proyecto.
• Experiencia en frameworks como Spring, JPA y Hibernate.
• Conocimientos en bases de datos relacionales.
• Capacidad de trabajar en equipo y adaptarse a diferentes proyectos.

• Un ambiente de trabajo dinámico y colaborativo.
• Proyectos retadores y en constante evolución.
• Formación continua y oportunidades de desarrollo profesional.
• Flexibilidad horaria y teletrabajo.

• Desarrollarás y mantendrás aplicaciones... en Java.

• Participarás en pruebas y depuración de código.
• Investigarás nuevas tecnologías y herramientas para mejorar los procesos de desarrollo.

Si te sientes identificado/a con nuestra filosofía y tienes ganas de formar parte de nuestro equipo, envíanos tu CV Estamos deseando conocerte

jobs_results.title: Java, Restful APIs, NodeJS developer (100% remote from Spain)
jobs_results.description:
🚀 UST is looking for the very Top Talent…and we would be delighted if you were to join our family!

More in details, UST is a multinational company based in North America, certified as a Top Employer company with over 35.000 employees all over the world and presence in more than 35 countries. We are leaders on digital technology services, and we provide large-scale technologic solutions to big companies.

🔎 What are we looking for?

We are looking for an Java, Restful APIs, NodeJS developer, working close to work in collaboration with the Digital Team.

📋 Job Responsibilities:

We value delivering high-quality products that meet the needs of our customers.

To this end, we are seeking candidates who will oversee the entire software development lifecycle, from planning to deployment and beyond.

Take responsibility of the software delivery by ensuring quality and scope expectations are met.

A software engineer who takes pride in their craftsmanship and in the results that they... deliver.

💡 Mandatory skills:

+3 years of experience, University degree in technology, preferably in computer science.

Extensive knowledge of working with distributed infrastructure systems and client-server architectures.

Back-end technologies such as NodeJS, MongoDB, Java, npm packaging, RESTful APIs.

Excellent working knowledge of both SQL and NoSQL databases.

Experience of using agile methodologies and TDD (test-driven development).

Experience with API development (REST)

Knowledge of continuous Integration and continuous delivery using Jenkins and the Nexus repository manager.

Knowledge of Docker, Git, GitHub, Openshift and MicroServices Architecture.

English C1

Valuable and desirable: being entitled of Disability Certificate.

Work location: 100% remote within Spain.

Work schedule: Business Hours. No intensive working days for friday or summer. L-V de 9.00 a 18.00 hours.

💰 What can we offer?

jobs_results.title: Java Developer - Fully Remote - 8083
jobs_results.description:
Recognized as the leading software development company, our client offers 100% remote modality and an excellent work environment where employees can thrive, and work in multicultural teams with flexible schedules and endless growth opportunities.

About the Role:

Join our dynamic Team as a Java Developer and drive innovation in a collaborative environment. You’ll enhance services, tools, and components within a collaborative Team by driving Agile solutions for internal and external challenges, ensuring top-notch software quality. Become a key player in our Core team, utilizing modern technologies to shape artifacts and support diverse groups, all while ensuring our software reaches new heights of excellence.

Main Activities:

- Maintain highly available systems exposed to high concurrency, ensuring robustness and stability.

- Introduce and communicate innovative ideas, methods, and technologies to enhance the technological stack.

- Actively participate in API design and... development processes.

- Uphold code quality standards, embracing Clean Code principles, and actively engaging in code review processes.

- Test scripts against code to ensure quality delivery.

Requirements:

- 5+ years of experience in Java.

- Experience in distributed services.

- Experience with the Spring and Spring-Boot frameworks.

- Knowledge of cloud applications.

- Expertise in designing and developing Microservices.

- Ability to work with relational and non-relational bases.

- Comfortable working in GMT+2 timezone.

- Native Spanish level.

- Intermediate English level.

Benefits:

- 100% remote work.

- Flexible hours - make your own schedule!

- Diverse and multicultural work environment.

- Paid parental leave, vacation & holidays.

- Hardware setup for you to work from home.

- Excellent compensation — well above the market average.

- Extensive opportunities for growth and professional development thanks to our mentoring system.

Enjoy the opportunity to have a dynamic lifestyle, better health, and wellness. Find renewed passion in your job, improve your productivity, and benefit from attractive growth opportunities for your career.

If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply
